$comment: Canonical, machine-checkable merge-gate policy for MarkFlow.
The live main ruleset requires only the aggregate Merge Gate context.
merge_gate_components are authoritative internal component jobs and are validated as a closed dependency graph.
The audit compares required producer definitions with workflow files and, when an explicit repository-administration credential is supplied, with the live rulesets.
Scheduled/manual workflow execution is credential-less by default; privileged live readback is explicit opt-in or external exit-audit evidence, never inferred from CI.

required.covers: Fail-closed aggregation of Build, Test, Inspect code, Verify plugin, PR Metadata Safety, and Dependency Review. The job runs with always() and succeeds only when every authoritative component result is exactly success.

staged_required.covers: Policy/producer integrity, workflow security checks, static analysis, and fail-closed fixtures
staged_required.promotion: Same-repository PR and merged-main reliability are proven. Promote only after an unprivileged fork PR proves this exact context is emitted and passes without privileged state, then re-read live administration state and update this policy and the live main ruleset atomically.

advisory.reason: Posted by Qodana itself and not stable across linter editions; Inspect code is the authoritative required job.

Security analysis surface. Qodana remains the authoritative required code-inspection gate; CodeQL is not promoted to required until stable PR/main evidence and an explicit merge-policy decision exist.

Security analysis surface. Qodana remains the authoritative required code-inspection gate; CodeQL is not promoted to required until stable PR/main evidence and an explicit merge-policy decision exist.

release_only.reason: Runs only from an explicit GitHub Release event after tag/source/version/artifact preflight; it is never a pull-request merge check.

$comment: gate checks are offline and run in the staged Hardening audit job on PR/push/schedule/manual events.
report checks require authoritative live GitHub readback and are run only from an explicit admin-controlled audit path.
The optional in-Actions live-readback job is disabled by default and requires an explicit repository-variable opt-in plus scoped credential.
The Hardening audit context itself remains staged_required until fork execution evidence and an atomic live promotion are both proven.

staged.blocked_by: Privileged live ruleset comparison remains report-only; the checked-in required set is the single Merge Gate context.
staged.when: during explicit hardening exit audits and after any live ruleset change

staged.blocked_by: Release-tag protection is verified by privileged live readback and is not a pull-request merge context.
staged.when: during explicit release-provenance or hardening exit audits

staged.blocked_by: Hardening audit remains staged separately from the single Merge Gate until unprivileged fork execution is proven.
staged.when: after an unprivileged fork PR proves Hardening audit execution and a separate reviewed policy decision explicitly chooses whether to aggregate or require that control

security_analysis_exceptions.evidence: CodeQL v4.38.1 / CLI 2.27.0 reports Kotlin version too new for the repository's maintained Kotlin 2.4 toolchain; autobuild also fails before extraction.
security_analysis_exceptions.retained_authority: Required Qodana Inspect code plus Build/Test/Plugin Verifier remain the Kotlin/JVM validation authority.
security_analysis_exceptions.reassessment_trigger: A CodeQL release explicitly supporting the maintained Kotlin toolchain.

merge_gate_components.covers: Kotlin/Gradle compile, webview TypeScript production build, plugin packaging; conservative docs-only and metadata-only fast paths retain the required job identity.
Gradle check (Kotlin unit tests) and the webview source test suite; conservative docs-only and metadata-only fast paths retain the component identity.
Authoritative Qodana static-analysis job, including its fail-closed SARIF threshold; conservative docs-only and metadata-only fast paths retain the component identity.
IntelliJ plugin structure verification and Plugin Verifier compatibility targets; conservative docs-only and metadata-only fast paths retain the component identity.
PR title/body squash-message safety. Revalidates edited metadata and rejects GitHub Actions skip directives before they can enter the squash commit message.
PR dependency-diff admission; rejects newly introduced known vulnerabilities at moderate severity or above. Metadata-only events preserve the component without rerunning an unchanged dependency diff.
